description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 29.01.2024 to 04.02.2024
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving the modification of financial regulations for customs operations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
